_meta.purpose: Bo cau mau goi y benh nhan hoi bac si. Sinh bang tra cuu theo cap (analyte_id, status), KHONG sinh bang LLM.
_meta.why_templates: Noi dung y khoa do tra cuu quyet dinh, LLM chi dien dat lai (ADR-008). Cau mau duyet truoc duoc, khong bao gio vuot ranh gioi, va test co dinh duoc - dieu ma dau ra ngau nhien khong lam duoc.
_meta.content_boundary: Moi cau phai chi chua du kien he thong da biet chac. Cam: ten benh cu the, dang 'toi co bi X khong', ten thuoc hoac lieu dung, de nghi mot xet nghiem/thu thuat cu the, gia thuyet nguyen nhan, gia dinh benh nhan dang dieu tri hoac dang dung thuoc.
_meta.placeholders: {name} = ten chi so dung nhu benh nhan nhap tren phieu cua ho. {value} = gia tri. {unit} = don vi.
_meta.status_keys: low | high | critical_low | critical_high. Chi so status=normal KHONG sinh cau hoi.
_meta.review: Duyet noi dung: chua. Can Duong (mien critical value) va nguoi phu trach noi dung y khoa doc lai truoc khi phat hanh.
